bench.criterion: CAN frame rates within 5% and ECU .mlg channel logging on a built pod.
bench.procedure: Connect the built pod and ECU to a bench CAN bus; retain timestamped traffic for all six specified frame IDs, compare rates with the spec, and retain an ECU .mlg file showing lean, brake pressure and suspension travel.

bench.criterion: RaceChrono Pro BLE pairing and combined ECU RPM, pod lean and 25 Hz GPS speed.
bench.procedure: Pair RaceChrono Pro with the built pod over BLE; retain the app session showing ECU RPM alongside pod lean and GPS speed and measure the GPS update rate against 25 Hz.

bench.criterion: Eight-channel range, accuracy and acquisition plus selected wheel speed/fault behavior under concurrent operation.
bench.procedure: Declare selected sensor ranges, error and sampling bounds; exercise all eight analog channels while wheel capture, IMU/GNSS, CAN, BLE and logging run. Retain timestamped acquisition/error results and front/rear wheel speed and fault tests over the declared range.

bench.criterion: Phone-independent logging duration/integrity and actual digital tire sensor/harness/zone coverage.
bench.procedure: Declare workload and achieved duration against the soft eight-hour target; record without a phone, test full media and power interruption/restart, and verify retained data integrity and parked wireless retrieval. Exercise the selected tire sensors over the declared harness and record actual zones and updates.

Owner acceptance of -20 to 85 degC is captured only for U1, U2 and U4 (operating-temperature-acceptances.txt sha256 7ca91bc748e3029432e5bb40501c056301429da08119759c612daea7cca8678a, lines 1-3). U3 (D-PCB-9) and J3 (D-PCB-12) are agent decisions without an owner acceptance line: until the owner accepts them or a part rated to 105 degC replaces them, they fail the part-selection criterion. Each obligation requires the exact MPN, manufacturer and package binding, the captured manufacturer rating, and part-bound thermal evidence for the evaluated assembly. Missing part-bound thermal evidence is unknown, never pass; a captured rating that does not cover the accepted range, or an expected part temperature above the rating, is a defect. Enclosure ambient may not stand in for the part's rated metric without evidence relating them.

POD-TEMP-UNRATED: NOT CHECKED: Of 305 references, 172 have a captured catalog rating of at least 105 degC, 5 are below it (POD-TEMP-ACTUAL-LIMITS), 117 bound parts have no captured operating-temperature rating, and 11 references (JP1, JP2, JP3, JP4, JP5, TP1, TP2, TP3, TP4, TP5, TP6) carry no part binding. Unknown ratings remain unknown, never pass; catalog ratings still need manufacturer confirmation (rev3-microsd/temperature-ratings.json).

POD-TEMP-ENCLOSURE: NOT CHECKED: Enclosure thermal validation must measure the selected components under worst-case supply, sensor load, radio and logging activity, including self-heating. Neither the +85 C board ambient envelope nor adequate margin to actual manufacturer limits is qualified. A passing assembly predicate does not discharge this obligation.
scope.name: Expanded telemetry pod Revision 3 campaign scope (microSD source)
scope.scope: Revision 3 accounting for all 59 requirements and 20 prose entries against the current microSD source, declared for the pod driver stage order schematic, placement, routing, verification. Native ERC, netlist, placement-projected DRC, routed DRC, copper facts and the fab_package done gate are the only executable checks; every other obligation remains explicit. Compilation is preparation, not native execution, placement, routing or acceptance.
